exposure: Uterine artery blood flow parameters (Peak systolic velocity [PSV], Resistance index [RI], Pulsatility index [PI])
cohort: The participants were 167 patients diagnosed with placenta previa between January 2018 and December 2022.
finding: Uterine artery blood flow parameters (PSV, RI, and PI) are significant predictors of placenta accreta severity in patients with placenta previa.
